name: GoThere
description: Walk over to the spot or object the player is pointing at and stay there for a while. Only if the NPC is willing; they can refuse in character instead. To walk to a person, use MoveTo instead.
note: Living World (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). The target is what the player points at in VR (the activation crosshair).
prompt: If the player points somewhere and asks you to go or stand 'over there', and you are willing to, begin your response with '{key}:'
